selected.title: Wise to pay clients' tax bills after third-party software error
selected.summary: Money transfer app Wise has contacted the UK's tax authorities over technical errors that led thousands of clients to pay the wrong amount of tax on their investments.
selected.why: Wise to pay clients' tax bills following software error.

reason: UK-focused regulatory and consumer finance issue with arguable positions on Wise's liability, disclosure duties, and software risk in fintech
angle: Whether fintech firms should bear full costs of third-party software failures or share responsibility with vendors depends on contractual allocation rules that need clarifying in regulation
